summary: The file is stated over fields although the definition and eight of its ten declarations need only `CommRing F`/`CommRing L` + `IsDomain L` — the wrapper at line 139 is strictly less general than the lemma it wraps in the same repo. Also `comp_perm` duplicates the proof of the more general `comp_perm_iff`, and `injective_iff_separable` is stated in the mapped form rather than the `f.Separable` form used everywhere else.
